Summary: This bill would require the Department of Finance (“DOF”) to expand its Fleet Program to include notices of violations for idling. More specifically, the bill would require the Department of Environmental Protection to electronically transmit idling violations issued to participants in the fleet program to DOF. Further, DOF would be required to include such notices of violations in their commercial customer online services portal and provide instructions for responding to such notices of violation.
Text:
A Local Law to amend the administrative code of the city of New York, in relation to including violations for idling in the fleet program

Be it enacted by the Council as follows:


Section 1. Chapter 1 of title 11 of the administrative code of the city of New York is amended by adding a new section 11-145 to read as follows:
§ 11-145 Fleet program for idling violations. a. Definitions. For purposes of this section, the term “fleet program” means the program set forth in section 39-03 of title 19 of the rules of the city of New York, regarding the parking violations bureau fleet program, or a successor program.
b. The department of finance shall include in the fleet program’s listings of newly issued summonses any notice of violation of subdivision (a) or (f) of section 24-163 that has been issued for a registration plate of a vehicle enrolled in such program. 
c. As part of the fleet program, the department of finance shall: 
1. share a list of companies and associated registration plates enrolled in the fleet program with the department of environmental protection no less than once a week; and  
2. provide, on the commercial customer online services portal or a successor portal, instructions for recipients of notices of violation of subdivision (a) or (f) of section 24-163 regarding how to respond to such notices of violations, including how to:
(a) plead guilty to such violation and pay any associated penalty; 
(b) plead guilty and cure such violation with the department of environmental protection; or 
(c) contest such violation. 
d. No less than once a week the department of environmental protection shall electronically transmit to the department of finance all notices of violation of subdivision (a) or (f) of section 24-163 issued for a registration plate enrolled in the fleet program.
e. Nothing herein shall be construed to replace or supersede the requirements contained in section 1049-a of the charter or any rules promulgated thereunder.
§ 2. This local law takes effect 180 days after it becomes law.
